_note: Checked-in map for lint/rule_audit.py. Each key is a `<!-- rule:<slug> -->` anchor in a file that lint/rule_audit.py RULE_FILES names. `mechanism.kind` is one of guard, check, ci, unmechanized, judgment. guard.ref must name a rule string passed to refuse()/record() in hooks/guard.py. check.ref must be a file path, relative to the repo root, that exists; a check row cites `test` (path::name, resolved by AST) and/or `setting` (a JSON value in settings.json), never a `needle`. ci.ref must name a `- name:` step in .github/workflows/checks.yml. unmechanized.reason must say what a hook or check would have to see. judgment.reason must say why only judgment can apply the rule.

mechanism.reason: Judging the outcome for the person served is a human read of context and consequence. No test scores outcome quality.
A stance for how to read a recorded decision, not an independently checkable action a hook can observe.
Naming a stale decision, measuring its statement, and proposing a fix are judgment calls in prose. Nothing parses staleness or fix quality.

Sorting a failing test into re-point-and-show-red-then-green, real defect, possibly-stale, or already-ruled-out is a judgment call on the failure's cause. Whether a builder or reviewer actually applied that reasoning is not something a hook can read from a diff. agents/builder.md and agents/reviewer.md carrying the 4-class list is checkable, but proving the check works needs a test fixture, and builders do not write tests; left to a test-author to mechanize that slice.

Whether a stated act matches the literal word given, versus a variant of it, and whether a test expects exactly the behaviour a ruling ruled out, are judgment calls on wording. No hook parses an instruction and an action for a match.
No hook reads the owner's request and judges which shape (solo, one lane or coordinator) fits it, or checks that the session said its pick in one line first.
Nothing counts the edits in a request or sees whether parts could run in parallel, so no check can tell a solo job from a one-lane or coordinator job.
No check classifies a diff as touching a rule's behaviour, a guard's or check's verdict, or program logic versus text, style, and content, so none can demand the reviewer.
Nothing watches a session's edit count or parallel parts over time, or sees whether the session said its switch to a larger shape in one line.

No hook classifies a session's own act as orchestration versus building, or judges whether a change can move a verdict. hooks/decision_watch.py, a Stop command hook, reads the transcript and this turn's git diff and judges the act, escalating to a model only for the residual judgment a diff cannot make, which is this rule's check.
No hook judges it. A prompt hook sees only the event input, never what an agent did, and no check reads an agent's roles.
No check reads whether a workflow agent takes its role through agentType or runs its model from the model-per-role table.
The owner ruled on 2026-09-28 that prose alone enforces the ceiling and that no forcing returns, so no hook or setting blocks a model above Sonnet.
Judging whether a task is Opus-shaped, and whether the assistant said so in one line first, is a human read of the transcript.

mechanism.reason: Nothing distinguishes a resumed agent from a freshly spawned one at the tool layer this repo governs.
No check counts checkouts against concurrent agents or catches two agents sharing one tree.
Lane assignment and briefing happen in chat and briefs, which no hook here reads.
Judged by the SendMessage wording judge (model claude-sonnet-5-5, in hooks/sendmessage_state.py); it moves to a mechanism after the judge makes a real catch.
No check can tell a guessed lane count from a measured one in prose.

A check would need the queue at turn end, each item's open questions, and which follow-ups the session found; no file holds them. The owner deferred a Stop check that refuses an idle turn end until the gap repeats (step c59, Oct 26).
Naming the open lanes correctly is a factual statement written in prose, not a structure a check can verify.

No check compares the ports or data paths two checkouts use.
Detecting an incident and confirming a re-verify followed it both need a human read of the transcript.

shared-trees-delete-names-absolute-path.test: hooks/test_guard.py::rm-var: the 2026-10-27 scratch delete, a cd then a relative glob, is refused

mechanism.reason: Branch protection on main is a GitHub repository setting, external to this codebase. No file here proves it is switched on.
Enforcement is GitHub's required-status-checks setting on the branch, not something this repo's files can attest to.
No hook sees that a cloud session is waiting on CI, or reads whether it set a send_later check-in. The ci-done comment covers the red-run wake; the check-in covers a lost wake.

mechanism.reason: No check enforces one file per decision or a separate folder per record kind.
Whether a new entry restates an open question or opens a new one is a judgment about meaning. A hook sees a new file, not its question.

Sequencing overlapping PRs into one integration branch and closing the originals is a manual coordination step. merge/merge.py refuses one part only: a batch that drops a lane by a revert (refuse_dropped_lane).
No harness renders every screen at every size and theme and demands a verdict line per screen.
Whether a headless or isolated browser would have done, and whether a login was needed for a given check, are judgment calls, not a loggable fact this repo captures.
No hook sees a browser launch, a screencapture call, or computer use before it happens and checks a one-line announcement preceded it.
No check reads whether a report about long work was verified against the repo instead of a status line. The mutation test's WRONG CAUSE verdict covers only mutant cause of death, not this.
No check reads whether a block-list was tested by running it for real. The guard suite drives the guard as a subprocess, but nothing proves a dry run would be refused.
No check confirms that a dependency bump takes the newest version that passes its checks, or that a pin records why.
lint/ste_lint.py checks sentence style, not whether a published number or path has a reader that actually checked it.
No check measures how much of a document a session read before acting on it.
No check tells a pasted verdict apart from a pasted stream, or counts the commands used to get it.
No check sees which command an agent ran a verification through. CI tests only that bin/verdict itself works.
Judged by the Agent prompt hook (model claude-sonnet-5-5, in settings.json); it moves to a mechanism after the hook makes a real catch.
No check tells whether the orchestrator read an agent's report or its full transcript.
Compaction content is a judgment call about what to keep. Nothing scores a compacted context against this rule.

Whether a section matters only under one folder, or is needed before the first file read, is a read of what the section governs. lint/check_claude_md_size.py warns past 200 lines, which prompts the move, but no check can judge which section moves.
Telling a guessed answer from a computed one needs a read of the reasoning, which no check performs.

The guard refuses a port item on the repo's waiting page with no Departs from line or with holds. Guard rule question-departs refuses any question to the owner with no valid Departs from line, or one whose change side says no change (a restatement of main); it cannot tell whether a claimed change really differs from main. It cannot read intent, so the reply judge (hooks/reply_judge.py, a model, never blocks) notes a reply that marks work blocked on a port question.

building-port-keeps-behaviour.test: hooks/test_guard.py::port question: today's item (port words, no Departs from, holds) is denied

mechanism.reason: Whether an ambiguity was surfaced or silently resolved is a judgment call on the reply's content.
No check compares a task's item list against a reply to catch a silently dropped item.

A hook would have to see two implementations of one capability in the repo. One narrow case has a guard: rule item-field-rendered refuses a waiting-item write that names a top-level field outside the one list in the itemFields block of page.html, which the page and the guard both read (decision item-field-rendered).
Distinguishing a cause fix from a symptom fix is a code-review judgment, not a parseable property.

mechanism.test: lint/test_scanner_traps.mjs::decision-watch machinePaths: comment opener // in a string does not hide the defect after it

mechanism.reason: Nothing checks that a design discussed in chat was later landed in a spec, a decision, or declared abandoned.
Judging whether a rule explanation ran to a paragraph is a style read, not a parsed structure.

Partly checked: lint/stale_cites.py (in the ste-lint CI step) refuses a Markdown line that names a file or Python def the same PR removed. A claim wrong in meaning is judged only by hooks/prose_judge.py, inside a decisions folder.

Judged by hooks/reply_judge.py, an async Stop command hook that calls Haiku at xhigh and returns a finding as a note on the next turn, per reply-judge-samples-never-refuses; it moves to a mechanism after the hook makes a real catch.

The check covers the landing case: a turn that lands a commit, push, merge or opened PR is not a tracking turn and ends with the report. The tracking-only case, one line on a turn that lands nothing, stays a content judgment.
No check compares a reply against an agent's report to catch an echoed copy or a described screenshot.

Judged by hooks/reply_judge.py, an async Stop command hook that calls Haiku at xhigh and returns a finding as a note on the next turn, per reply-judge-samples-never-refuses; it moves to a mechanism after the hook makes a real catch.
Judged by the AskUserQuestion agent hook (model claude-opus-5-5, in settings.json); it moves to a mechanism after the hook makes a real catch.
The report guard accepts any in-order subset of the four labels, so it cannot see whether a label that stays in the report is empty or does not apply.
The numbers come from live git and GitHub reads at report time; no guard or check reads them.
No check reads whether a session's last PR merged with no lane open, or whether the final report offered the sweep command.
The report guard returns early when nothing landed, so no check sees a report written on such a turn.

A design principle. Cases in hooks/test_guard.py cover the guard's own recovery path: checkout or switch to main in the pointer checkout, and the clone still editable. No check reads the principle in other controls.
No check reads a green result and reports which platforms and fixture states it did not cover. The CI matrix runs three platforms, which is coverage, not a check on how a reader treats the green.
Whether a memory entry's ruling has a tracked home on main is a read of the repo against the entry's meaning. No hook matches the two yet.

Nothing checks that an answer given in chat reached a decision or a deferred item before the work it governs merged. A check would have to pair each AskUserQuestion answer with a tracked path that a later report names.

Whether a question names what the session does meanwhile, whether the session kept working on what does not depend on the answer, and whether it reached the waiting page after 5 minutes unanswered in chat, or with its chat answer, is a content judgment. No check counts the 5 minutes: a timer is refused by rule outcomes-mechanize-rules. The session-board mod refuses a question box while this session's agents or background commands run, and once it has started another session (record session-board-mod-limits). The Stop reply judge (hooks/reply_judge.py, a model, never blocks) notes an Input Needed item whose pick rule parallelism-keep-going lets the session take with no question, and a reply that marks work blocked on, or an item as blocking, a question about a port or redesign of an existing app, or that asks such a question with no Departs from line. Code sends every Stop with the words blocked on to the judge off-sample. The waiting-page writer refuses a port item with no Departs from line or with holds (guard rule port-question, rule building-port-keeps-behaviour). It refuses a decision with no Problem line naming its stake (goal, money, risk, rule or cannot undo) unless the session's own pick stands (guard rule owner-judge, decision owner-judge-test), and one with no Goal or Based on line or an option with no gain or lose (guard rule question-form, decision question-form). It refuses an option key that is not the lowercase letter of its position, and item text that names an option by a letter-and-digit key (guard rule option-letter-keys, decision option-keys-are-letters). It refuses an open item whose text says it is being reworked (guard rule rework-off-page, decision rework-leaves-page). It refuses a decision, a chat question with options and an Input Needed pick with no valid Departs from line, or one whose change side restates main (guard rule question-departs, decision port-keeps-behaviour). The feedback guard (hooks/feedback_guard.py, cases in hooks/test_feedback_inbox.py) blocks a `[page] -> page:<n>` inbox item with no send to the page writer. A tool the auto-mode classifier refused is noted by hooks/refusal_note.py, and the Stop report guard (lint/report_guard.py) blocks until the reply raises it under Input Needed (decision refusals-reach-the-owner).

Judged by hooks/reply_judge.py, an async Stop command hook that calls Haiku at xhigh and returns a finding as a note on the next turn, per reply-judge-samples-never-refuses; it moves to a mechanism after the hook makes a real catch.

Whether a reply narrates a limit kept or a check passed, or names one because it blocked the work or changed the plan, is a content judgment. The Stop reply judge (hooks/reply_judge.py, a model, never blocks) notes a breach.
Whether a question was simple, and whether the answer held to 1 to 3 sentences, is a content judgment.
No check reads whether the user asked for full detail and whether the reply then gave it.
No check finds an error report, failing output, security warning, or destructive confirmation and measures whether it was cut.
Whether a reply dropped a true and needed fact to stay short is a judgment no check can make.
No check holds a list of jargon, and plain words depend on what the reader already knows.

The one form check, hooks/question_form.py (decision question-form), refuses a chat question box (through hooks/call_judge.py, before any model call) and a waiting-page decision that lacks the Goal, Problem or Based on lines, a valid Departs from line (guard rule question-departs), an option's gain or loss, or marks a widening option as the pick or the recommendation. It reads words, so an unmarked widening option and a false stake pass; the question judge model reads what code cannot (a plain gain and lose, unexplained ids, a pointer outside the box).

style-question-form.test: hooks/test_question_form.py::guard.data_tool_hit gives item 92 the verdict question_form.item_hit gives (one home)

mechanism.reason: Whether a step handed to the user was doable, and whether its block is runnable as is, is a judgment on the reply and the tools available. The Stop reply judge (hooks/reply_judge.py, a model, never blocks) samples 1 Stop in 5 and judges every report that carries Input Needed, for the reason and the check on each item. A finding writes one guard.log line. A block that mixes shells has no code check. Guard rule task-names-check refuses a waiting-page task with no Why yours line (decision task-names-its-check). Guard rule gh-login-switch refuses a waiting-page task whose command runs gh with no gh auth switch to a known login before it (decision act-in-place).

Whether a table compares, and whether a column states the gold standard or target, is a judgment on the reply. Code in hooks/reply_judge.py finds a Markdown table and sends that Stop to the reply judge (a model, never blocks) off-sample; the model flags a comparison table with no such column, and a finding writes one guard.log line. It moves to a mechanism after the hook makes a real catch.

The guard refuses a waiting-page option, or task steps read together, that has a press verb and a web marker with no link to the exact page (decision act-in-place). It reads words, so a press verb outside its list (such as enable auto-merge, select or close) passes, and an unnumbered press passes with any link.

mechanism.reason: The guard refuses a waiting-page task whose steps, joined, name a file and a command in it, whose step holds a shell line in backticks, or whose command is not both powershell and mac (decision act-in-place). It reads words, so a step that sends the owner to a file in other words passes.

style-command-in-item.test: hooks/test_guard.py::command in item: a step that opens a plan file, then one that says run its command, is denied

mechanism.reason: No check can see the question box. A hook reads the call input, not what the user sees, so whether the text sat inside the box or before it is unseen.
A hook for this rule is built on branch local-time-line and is not yet on main. This entry moves to a check when that branch merges.
No check can tell an estimate from a measured range, or know whether a sample count backs a duration. It is a content judgment on the reply.
Whether a question was a status question, and whether the reply took the report shape, is a content judgment. No check reads that.
Whether the owner named the wrong tier, or brought work that belongs to another tier, is a content judgment. No check reads that.
Whether a reply offers the printed override line as a ready answer is a content judgment. No check reads that.
Which layer ran which proof lives in agent transcripts and briefs. No check reads who reran a passing suite.
Whether a named incident, measured risk or likely risk justifies a rule is a human read of the rule's record. Grow while things change, then cull what never fired (owner, 2026-10-21).

Round counts live in briefs and reviewer reports. No check reads how many rounds a PR had. The hold rests on the round-3 reviewer's 'Net safety value:' line in agents/reviewer.md, which the orchestrator reads. No check blocks the merge of a held lane.
A prose rule. No check reads the debt store yet; one would have to find each open finding in the repo and check that it has a debt.
